description: Map a company's social media presence across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube. Returns profile URLs and follower counts in flat Clay-ready JSON. Profiles are discovered from the company's own homepage links, a web search fallback, and pattern guessing, then validated against the company. Follower counts are extracted where public; X is URL-only (its count needs login) and Instagram and Facebook counts are best-effort. Provide at least one of company_domain or company_name. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_domain.description: Bare company domain, e.g. stripe.com. Provide this or company_name.

company_name.description: Optional company name. Improves search accuracy and disambiguation. Provide this or company_domain.

includeFollowerCounts.description: Fetch profile pages to extract follower counts (default true). Set false for URLs only, which is cheaper.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

platforms.description: Which platforms to map. Defaults to all five.

skipCache.description: Force a fresh lookup and ignore the 7 day result cache.

name: map_company_social_presence
title: Map Company Social Presence
